facts.fact: According to Statista research cited by Adobe, programmatic advertising accounted for 80% of all digital ad spend in the US in 2024.
facts.unit: % of all digital ad spend in the US
facts.quote: In 2024, programmatic advertising accounted for 80% of all digital ad spend in the US, while 60% of advertisers in the US planned to increase their investment

facts.fact: According to Statista research cited by Adobe, 60% of advertisers in the US planned to increase their investment in programmatic advertising.
facts.quote: while 60% of advertisers in the US planned to increase their investment, according to Statista research

facts.fact: Adobe describes programmatic software setup as having 3 steps: brands set campaign parameters such as target audience, budget, and geographical reach; the platform connects with publishers selling ad space; and AI analysis informs an automated real-time bidding auction.
facts.quote: How programmatic software works in 3 steps.
